title: Insurance submission first
challenge_the_fun_part: You must produce a valid, sensible file for a contest that never tells you your score, so correctness of format is the whole game.
cheapest_experiment: Local validator against the printed sequences (offset 0, tags = 0, unique values, numbering round-trip) plus a CDR3/position paratope prior and an exposure prior shrunk to ~0.04; about 2 CPU-hours; upload 2026-10-20.
kill_test: Any mismatch against template sequences blocks upload; a file whose values contain ties or whose seqNum is off by 22 fails the round-trip test.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Page captures and handoffs silently corrupted evidence (a stale home page said seven targets).
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Treat each handoff as an exhibit register entry and audit it; this exposed the stale home page and the header-only uploader.

title: Consensus of many co-folding runs
challenge_the_fun_part: A single AI pose is right about one time in three, so the puzzle is turning many wrong-ish guesses into trustworthy per-residue probabilities.
cheapest_experiment: Boltz-2, Chai-1, OpenFold3 (Protenix-v1) x 5-20 seeds x 5 samples on ONU11/13/23 and on 9MTE/9MTX; ipSAE-weighted Voronota-LT contact frequency, mean over seeds, shrunk by split-half disagreement. Measure seconds per seed first (about 12-14 GPU-h is an extrapolation).
kill_test: On 9MTE/9MTX the consensus must beat the exposure prior (and unshrunk mean contact); macro lift over per-complex shuffle null must be >= ~1.5x, else do not submit it as the main arm.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Recovering a message from many noisy intercepts.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Frequency analysis: repeated patterns across intercepts carry the signal; split-half agreement tells you when the histogram has converged (hive analogy, q5/q9).

title: Nanobody-side paratope head
challenge_the_fun_part: The nanobody half is the easy half, so the fun is beating a trivial 'CDR3 is the contact' rule honestly.
cheapest_experiment: Probe on ESM-2 / AbLang-2 / IgBert (MIT/BSD) trained on SAbDab-nano with CDR3-cluster grouped folds; compare with the CDR-variability prior (0.562 on CDR residues) and the positional damage map.
kill_test: Drop it unless it exceeds the prior by >= 0.05 on the proxies; check on 5 HER2 VHHs after ANARCI renumbering.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Judging which parts of a painting are original when the surface is overpainted.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Use a hand-set damage map (known regions of high change) as a prior; hive version scored 0.547 vs 0.149 prevalence on 17 VHH complexes.

title: Antigen exposure prior with an occupancy mask
challenge_the_fun_part: On a 600-residue antigen where only 3-5% touch, the game is to say less, more precisely.
cheapest_experiment: Exposure (RSA) x (1 - dimer-occupied patch of ~51 residues) x a mild public-footprint term, blended with uniform and shrunk to ~0.04.
kill_test: Remove the mask if it does not lower mean AP-by-position on the 4 public VHH epitopes, or hurts held-out AP; kill the whole prior if it does not beat uniform.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Where a species can live versus where it does live (niche models from presence-only records).
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Separate the fundamental niche from the realised niche with an occupancy mask and fit with PU-style statistics; the hive notes that presence-only intercepts are unidentifiable, so rank only (Fithian and Hastie 2013).

title: Weight-of-evidence fusion
challenge_the_fun_part: Several weak clues (consensus, exposure, language-model, domain hint) must be added without double-counting.
cheapest_experiment: Convert each source to log-odds, cluster correlated sources, sum, map back to 0-1 with unique values.
kill_test: Revert to the best single source if the sum does not beat it by >= 0.03 macro PR-AUC after clustering.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Combining many weak, roughly independent clues about a key.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Add log-odds in decibans; valid only when clues are independent, so cluster correlated clues first (hive q9).

title: Competition-column domain gate
challenge_the_fun_part: One free hint exists: trastuzumab depleted ONU13 more than 20-fold but not ONU11 or ONU23.
cheapest_experiment: Use only as a soft prior on domain IV for ONU13 (down-weight for the others) once q1/q3 confirm which domain the competing antibodies bind; needs the gated table.
kill_test: Discard if the domain mapping cannot be verified or if the gate lowers AP on any proxy where the answer is known.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: A screening test with a low prior and weak specificity (prosecutor's fallacy).
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Combine the test with the base rate by Bayes instead of trusting a positive; PPV about 27% at a 3% prior (estimate, q3).

title: Walk-forward validation on post-cutoff structures
challenge_the_fun_part: Without a score from the site, the fun is building an honest league table from four public complexes.
cheapest_experiment: Voronota-LT area>0 table for 5MY6/7QVK/9MTE x2/9MTX (+8GZ5 sanity); leave-one-complex-out; paired bootstrap; antigen and VHH reported separately; templates on/off and old vs new weights ablation.
kill_test: If an arm's rank on 9MTE/9MTX contradicts its rank on 5MY6/7QVK beyond a preset margin, treat the earlier gain as memorisation.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Backtesting a rating model without peeking at the future.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Walk-forward: evaluate only on events after the model's information cutoff (hive q8).

title: Pick the simpler arm when the gap is small
challenge_the_fun_part: With only three test complexes, humility is a strategy.
cheapest_experiment: Pre-register at most 2-3 arms and the margin before looking; use the five-submission ladder (floor, prior blend, consensus, ensemble, reserve).
kill_test: If the local leave-one-complex-out bootstrap CIs (~0.18) of two arms overlap, submit the simpler one.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Overfitting a tiny public test set (Netflix margin 0.00001 RMSE, tie broken by 20 minutes; Roelofs 2019 across 120 Kaggle competitions).
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Winners added new information and blended, and large leaderboards showed little overfitting; small test sets are the outliers (hive q9).

title: Settle the scorer before the deadline
challenge_the_fun_part: The metric's fine print (pooling, AP vs trapezoid, best vs last) can reverse the winner.
cheapest_experiment: Post one precise question on the HF Space community tab; meanwhile write probabilities with chain base rates preserved (antigen ~0.05, VHH ~0.15) and unique values.
kill_test: n/a as a model idea; success is a written answer from the organisers, or a file that is robust under all variants.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: What counts as proof depends on the standard of proof.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Make the answer robust to the standard: rank by the fraction of cutoffs that agree, since the area-weighted metric is near cutoff-proof.

title: Keep NGS tables for lineage and splits, not location
challenge_the_fun_part: The big dataset cannot say where on HER2 a nanobody binds; the fun is knowing exactly why.
cheapest_experiment: Use only for family structure, grouped-CV folds, and sanity checks; no GPU time.
kill_test: Revisit only if a competition-column cluster with a known domain label matches an ONU CDR3 family.

analogous_solved_problem.problem: Learning a dictionary between two languages without parallel text.
analogous_solved_problem.how_overcome: Works only with two populations and thousands of pairs; here one HER2 sequence faces 1e5-1e6 VHH, so the dictionary cannot be learned (hive q9).
